method: For every wave51-fix browserRef cell with a same-width capture: count capture pixels in the 16px image frame (columns x<16 = left, x>=W-16 = right, rows y<16 = top) that differ from the frozen ref by >8/255 on any channel. The ref frame is image-space padding (capture-browser-ref.mjs padPngBuffer), so any capture ink there is ink the ref cannot have. Classes: overrun-right (right only), overrun-left (left only), overrun-top (top only), frame-colour(all-sides) (all three differ: a canvas-background class, not this family), mixed.

totals.note: clean-frame cells (no frame divergence, status ok) are omitted here to keep the artifact small; regenerate with the method above.
